turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

I have really bad pain in my lower chest and upper chest—like a knife-stab, violent, sickening pain. It also goes to my thoracic spine and my left scapula, and I feel very nauseous with repeated vomiting.

I’m sorry you’re going through that. **One question at a time:**  

**1) When did this pain start, and is it constant or coming in waves?**
It started very fast—like within minutes, maybe with an onset speed of 7 out of 10. The pain is very intense, 10 out of 10, and it feels constant/ongoing rather than just coming and going.
**2) Do you have any shortness of breath, sweating/clamminess, or feeling faint with the pain?**
I don’t think I have shortness of breath, sweating/clamminess, or feeling faint—at least I haven’t noticed those.
**3) Does the pain get worse with breathing in, coughing, or changing position (like leaning forward or lying flat)?**
Yes, it feels worse when I breathe in. I’m not sure about coughing or changing position—I haven’t paid close attention to that.
**4) Have you had any fever or recent cough/viral symptoms (sore throat, runny nose, flu-like illness) in the last few days?**
No fever and no recent cough or viral symptoms that I know of.
**5) Any history of heart disease, high blood pressure, high cholesterol, smoking, or diabetes?**
My medical history is unknown to me—I don’t really have anything I can say for sure about heart disease, high blood pressure, high cholesterol, smoking, or diabetes.
**6) How old are you, and what sex were you assigned at birth?**
I’m 43 years old. I’m female.
**7) Do you have any leg swelling or pain (especially one-sided), or have you been immobilized/recently traveled/surgery in the past month?**
No leg swelling or leg pain that I’ve noticed. I haven’t had surgery or been immobilized, and I haven’t had recent international travel.
**8) Have you had any recent long car/plane rides, or are you on estrogen-containing birth control or hormone therapy?**
No long car or plane rides. And I don’t know about estrogen-containing birth control or hormone therapy—I can’t say for sure.
**9) Have you had any blood in your vomit, black/tarry stools, or severe heartburn/reflux symptoms?**
I’ve had repeated vomiting, but I don’t know about blood in the vomit. I also don’t know about black/tarry stools. I haven’t said to myself that I have severe heartburn or reflux symptoms.
**10) Any trouble swallowing, drooling, or a “hot potato” muffled voice—or feeling like your throat is closing?**
No trouble swallowing, no drooling, and no muffled voice. I don’t feel like my throat is closing.
**11) Any wheezing, history of asthma/COPD, or does the pain feel like it comes with chest tightness?**
No wheezing and no known asthma/COPD. The pain is tight and very intense, but I don’t know how to describe it exactly as “chest tightness.”
**12) When you press on your chest or upper abdomen, does it reproduce the pain (musculoskeletal tenderness), or is it clearly internal?**
I haven’t tried pressing on it to see if it reproduces the pain. It feels internal to me, but I can’t be 100% sure.
**13) On a scale of 0–10, how bad is the pain now, and is it getting worse, improving, or unchanged since it started?**
It’s a 10 out of 10 right now. It feels like it’s not improving—more like it’s staying very bad since it started.
**14) Any neurologic symptoms—weakness, numbness, facial droop, new severe headache, or rash?**
No weakness, numbness, facial droop, rash, or new severe headache.
[DDX] Possible NSTEMI / STEMI, Pulmonary embolism, Acute pulmonary edema, Pericarditis, Pneumonia
